acceptance: Resolve GitHub issue #1 to v0.0.0.1 and retain that mapping through repeated registration.
Reject duplicate, deleted, or changed issue-version assignments.
Publish a public CI receipt for issue #1 with the fix revision, tested checkout, and exact run attempt.
The combined draft PR produces exactly two receipts, one per checkpoint.
Each receipt identifies its own GitHub issue and the corresponding fix commit.
A docs-only commit changes candidate and tested revisions while preserving both fix commits.
Create a standalone Version-Issues-Hub branch from a pinned source without modifying product refs or copying source issue records.
Generate an adopter-specific empty ledger and provenance record; accept existing three-component baselines.
Refuse occupied branches, conflicting identity, and empty repositories without silently modifying the target. Verify creation using public-runner tests.
